name: Mirroring - New Source: SQL Server On-Prem
description: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire SQL server on-prem database in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your existing SQL Server on-prem data directly into Fabric's OneLake. Inside Fabric, you can unlock powerful business intelligence, artificial intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and data sharing scenarios.
